svg.title: Shared mesh of the occupied six-Face Body boundary
svg.desc: Numeric isometric projection of all 290 shared binary64 positions and 576 indexed triangles. Six colors identify Face roles; dark lines follow 12 sampled CAD Edges. This is an approximate CPU mesh view, not GPU rendering or a new Solid certificate.

g.text: 290 vertices · 576 triangles · original XYZ in mm · uniform isometric projection
Native topology: 8 Vertices / 12 Edges / 6 Faces / 24 Uses. Mesh diagonals are separate.
Colors identify Face roles. Triangles are approximate; the original material proof remains in the Body.
